For the training, validation and testing data sets:

* They shall be subject to data governance and management practices (Article 10(2))
* They shall meet the quality criteria, including being relevant, sufficiently representative, free of errors, and complete (Article 10(3))
* They shall be subject to examination for possible biases (Article 10(2)(f))
* They shall have appropriate statistical properties (Article 10(3))

For the logging of the high-risk AI system:

* The logging capabilities shall provide, at a minimum, the recording of the period of each use, the reference database, the input data, and the identification of the natural persons involved in the verification of the results (Article 12(3))
